name: Opium Running
summary: Opium Running drops players into a flat, boxed-in forest where every tree is a platform and every branch is an opportunity. The environment is simple but vertical, letting you climb high, leap across gaps, and surprise opponents from above. Movement is fast and fluid, turning each chase into a creative parkour run through the trees.
